In this notebook, I will compute correlation values

# Setup


```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggpubr)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
colIBD <- "#EB6D33"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("iCD", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))

colCellgroups <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 7, "Set1")[c(1:5,7)]
names(colCellgroups) <- c("ColEpi", "Stroma", "Myeloid", "Plasma", "BCell", "TNKILC")

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

logInf <- function(x){ifelse(x == 0, log(1/1000), log(x))}

moveNode <- function(thistblgraph, name, xnudge = 0, ynudge = 0){
  thisrow <- which(thistblgraph$name == name)
  thistblgraph[thisrow,"x"] <- thistblgraph[thisrow,"x"] + xnudge
  thistblgraph[thisrow,"y"] <- thistblgraph[thisrow,"y"] + ynudge
  return(thistblgraph)
}
```


# Read Data

## Obs

```{r}
obs <- readRDS("out/annotations/scvi/251017__predictCOL_CB_allcells_obs.rds")
obs
```

```{r}
selectedstates <- c("Th1", "Th17", "PD1Hi Tfh")
```

## Correlations

```{r}
CellFreqDF <- PlotBoxplotsProp(df = obs %>% 
                                 filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
                                 add_count(cellstate, name = "cellstate_count") %>% filter(cellstate_count >= 100) %>%
                                 droplevels,
                 ann.col = "cellstate", 
                 relative.to = "celltype", 
                 exportDF = T
                ) %>% 
  complete(biopsy, cellstate, fill = list(annotation.freq = 0, denominator.freq = 0, prop = 0), explicit = TRUE) %>% 
  group_by(biopsy) %>% 
  fill(diagSub) %>% 
  group_by(cellstate) %>% 
  fill(celltype) %>% 
  ungroup

CellFreqDF
```


```{r}
compare.vector <- CellFreqDF$cellstate %>% unique %>% as.character 
compare.vector

CompareDF <- CellFreqDF %>%
    filter(cellstate %in% compare.vector) %>%
    mutate(cellstate = as.character(cellstate)) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = biopsy, names_from = cellstate, values_from = prop) %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = c(everything(), -one_of("biopsy")), .fn = ~ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

CompareDF
```

```{r}
CellCorDF.pearson <- CellFreqDF %>% 
    filter(cellstate %in% selectedstates) %>% 
    left_join(., CompareDF, by = "biopsy") %>%
    group_by(cellstate) %>%
    mutate(
        across(
            .cols = all_of(compare.vector),
            .fns = ~cor(., prop, method = "pearson")
        )
    ) %>%
    ungroup %>%
    distinct(cellstate, .keep_all=T) %>%
    arrange(cellstate, .locale = "en") %>%
    select(cellstate, all_of(compare.vector))

CellCorDF.pearson

CellCorMat.pearson <- CellCorDF.pearson %>% arrange(cellstate, .locale = "en") %>% column_to_rownames("cellstate") %>% as.matrix
```

```{r}
CellCorDF.pearson.sig <- CellFreqDF %>% 
    filter(cellstate %in% selectedstates) %>% 
    left_join(., CompareDF, by = "biopsy") %>%
    group_by(cellstate) %>%
    mutate(
        across(
            .cols = all_of(compare.vector),
            .fns = ~cor.test(., prop, method = "pearson")$p.value
        )
    ) %>%
    ungroup %>%
    distinct(cellstate, .keep_all=T) %>%
    arrange(cellstate, .locale = "en") %>%
    select(cellstate, all_of(compare.vector))

CellCorDF.pearson.sig

CellCorMat.pearson.sig <- CellCorDF.pearson.sig %>% column_to_rownames("cellstate") %>% as.matrix
```


```{r}
corr.list <- lapply(rownames(CellCorMat.pearson), function(x) {
  intersect(which(CellCorMat.pearson.sig[x,] <= 1e-3) %>% names, which(CellCorMat.pearson[x,] > 0) %>% names)
})
names(corr.list) <- rownames(CellCorMat.pearson)
corr.list
```

```{r}
selectedCorrList <- lapply(corr.list, function(thesecellstates) {

selectedCorrDF <- CellFreqDF %>% 
    filter(cellstate %in% thesecellstates) %>% 
  droplevels %>% 
    left_join(., CompareDF %>% select(biopsy, all_of(thesecellstates)), by = "biopsy") %>%
    group_by(cellstate) %>%
    mutate(
        across(
            .cols = all_of(thesecellstates),
            .fns = ~cor(., prop, method = "pearson")
        )
    ) %>%
    ungroup %>%
    distinct(cellstate, .keep_all=T) %>%
    arrange(cellstate, .locale = "en") %>%
    select(cellstate, all_of(thesecellstates))

selectedCorrDF

})
```

```{r}
selectedCorrListSig <- lapply(corr.list, function(thesecellstates) {

selectedCorrDF <- CellFreqDF %>% 
    filter(cellstate %in% thesecellstates) %>% 
  droplevels %>% 
    left_join(., CompareDF %>% select(biopsy, all_of(thesecellstates)), by = "biopsy") %>%
    group_by(cellstate) %>%
    mutate(
        across(
            .cols = all_of(thesecellstates),
            .fns = ~cor.test(., prop, method = "pearson")$p.value
        )
    ) %>%
    ungroup %>%
    distinct(cellstate, .keep_all=T) %>%
    arrange(cellstate, .locale = "en") %>%
    select(cellstate, all_of(thesecellstates))

selectedCorrDF

})
```

```{r}
pearsonList.out <- c(selectedCorrList, selectedCorrListSig)
names(pearsonList.out)
names(pearsonList.out) <- paste0(c(rep("Corr_", 3), rep("Sig_", 3)), names(pearsonList.out))
pearsonList.out <- pearsonList.out[c(1,4,2,5,3,6)]
names(pearsonList.out)
pearsonList.out
```

```{r}
writexl::write_xlsx(pearsonList.out, 
                    "out/correlation/Th1Th17Tfh_Pearson_Correlation.xlsx", 
                    col_names = TRUE, 
                    format_headers = TRUE)
```

## Geometric Means

```{r}
CellFreqDF.wide <- CellFreqDF %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(biopsy, diagSub), names_from = cellstate, values_from = prop)

CellFreqDF.wide
```

```{r}
CellFreqDF.wide.scored <- CellFreqDF.wide %>% 
  rowwise %>%
  mutate(geommean.th1 = pick(all_of(corr.list$Th1)) %>% as.matrix %>% logInf %>% rowMeans(., na.rm = T) %>% exp, .before = biopsy) %>% 
  mutate(geommean.th17 = pick(all_of(corr.list$Th17)) %>% as.matrix %>% logInf %>% rowMeans(., na.rm = T) %>% exp, .before = biopsy) %>% 
  mutate(geommean.tfh = pick(all_of(corr.list$`PD1Hi Tfh`)) %>% as.matrix %>% logInf %>% rowMeans(., na.rm = T) %>% exp, .before = biopsy) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  left_join(., obs %>% select(biopsy, antitnf_response, severity_score, severity_score_range, participant_id, timepoint) %>% distinct(biopsy, .keep_all = T), by = "biopsy")


CellFreqDF.wide.scored
```

```{r}
write_csv(CellFreqDF.wide.scored, "out/correlation/Th1Th17Tfh_GeometricMeans.csv")
```

## Network

```{r}
selectedCorrListNetwork <- lapply(selectedCorrList, function(selectedCorrDF) {
  selectedCorrNetwork <- selectedCorrDF %>% 
    pivot_longer(-cellstate) %>% 
    rename(from = cellstate, to = name, correlation = value) %>% 
    filter(from != to)
  
  selectedCorrNetwork <- selectedCorrNetwork[!duplicated(as.data.frame(t(apply(selectedCorrNetwork[,1:2], 1, sort)))),]
  selectedCorrNetwork
})

selectedCorrListNetwork
```

```{r}
selectedCorrListNetworkDF <- plyr::ldply(selectedCorrListNetwork, .id = "cellstate")
selectedCorrListNetworkDF
```

```{r}
write_csv(selectedCorrListNetworkDF, "out/correlation/Th1Th17Tfh_Correlation_Edges.csv")
```

```{r}
minCorrFilter <- 0.35
minCorrShow <- 0.5
selectedCorrGGraph <- selectedCorrListNetworkDF %>%
  arrange(correlation) %>% 
  filter(correlation >= minCorrFilter) %>%
  mutate(correlation = ifelse(correlation < minCorrShow, 0.1, correlation)) %>% 
  group_by(cellstate) %>% 
  as_tbl_graph %>% 
  activate("edges") %>% 
  mutate(cellstate = fct_relevel(cellstate, c("Th1", "Th17", "PD1Hi Tfh"))) %>% 
  ggraph(layout = 'kk', maxiter = 150) 

th1shift <- -1
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "TFPI2Hi Fibro.", 0.5, 0.75)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Inflm. Mac", th1shift, 0.5)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Th1", th1shift, 0.5)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Treg", th1shift+0.35, 0.75)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "XCL+ NK", -0.5, 1)

th17shift <- -0.5
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "CCL24+ Gob.", th17shift-0.35, 0.35)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "LGR5+ Epi.", th17shift-0.6, 0.25)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Venule", th17shift-0.6, 0.1)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "MNP", th17shift-0.8, 0.15)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Th17", th17shift+0, -0.2)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Prlf. Teff", th17shift-0.5, -0.1)

tfhshift <- -2.5
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "SAA+ Epi.", -0.75, 0.15)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "PDPNHi Fibro.", -1.5, 0.4)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "IgG1 PC", tfhshift-0.2, 1.1)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "GC-like BC", tfhshift+0.5, 0.75)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Plasmablast", tfhshift-0.25, 0.5)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Prlf. BC", tfhshift-0.25, 0.5)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "PD1Hi Tfh", tfhshift+0, 0.5)

selectedCorrNodes <- selectedCorrGGraph$data %>% 
  select(name, x, y) %>% 
  rename(cellstate = name)

selectedCorrNodes
```

```{r}
write_csv(selectedCorrNodes, "out/correlation/Th1Th17Tfh_Correlation_Nodes.csv")
```
